question: Can the unchanged source-bound authored scene preserve gameplay, local continuity and complete notices in a reproducible private-runtime Windows recipient?
beneficiary: A Windows recipient inspecting the existing original scene without checkout, SDK or Node.
method: Anchor unchanged managed/source/web files to the trusted Linux archive and its source closure; retain compiled journal rules identity.
Anchor every Windows runtime byte and notices to the official10.0.12 win-x64 archive SHA512.
Adapt twice in separate staging directories; compare ZIP bytes within one environment and exact payload bytes across environments.
Recover archived source with pinned SDK10.0.401 and compare all ten managed application files on Linux; do not call this a Windows compilation.
Execute the extracted package on an actual Windows x64 hosted runner from a path with spaces and unrelated working directory; recipient PATH resolves neither dotnet nor Node.
Record OS, architecture, commit and administrator token; make no URLACL, privilege or execution-policy changes.
Observe actual refusal, private consent, costs, nested encounter, process reentry during travel, observed return, delivery and unfinished work in actual Chromium.
Replay one journal generated by the unchanged actual Linux owner on Windows; only claim this exact binary/runtime journal pair, never automatic future migration.
Reject rehashed forged application/runtime and missing notices at inspection; reject missing payload/notices, corrupt save and invalid port at actual Windows launch.
Keep source stability guards, raw failures and screenshots; agents and repeated software controls are not participants or independent studies.
acceptance: Actual Windows extracted consumer succeeds with preserved state and notices; source identity, source recovery and repeatability pass. Published workflow or cross-adaptation alone is not execution.
negative_policy: Retain actual runner, launcher, source, permission, browser or continuity failures and diagnose without bypassing policy or weakening gates. If Windows execution is unavailable, classify delivery as prepared/unexecuted.
maturity: Build/Operations remains incomplete: licensed Unity Editor, activation/modules and actual Unity Windows production acceptance are still unresolved. Ten prior bounded methods retain their scope.
limits: No normal-user/device breadth, player/author assessment, power-loss/distributed guarantee, commercial clearance, production ownership, Unity or Steam claim. The same scene is not another North Star implementation unit.
